entities.name: Félicien Ntambue Kasembe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félicien Ntambue Kasembe, CICM is a Congolese prelate of the Catholic Church and a member of the Congregation of the Immaculate Heart of Mary who has been metropolitan archbishop of Kananga since May 2024. He was bishop of Kabinda from 2020 to 2024. Before he became a priest in 2001, he did missionary work in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Mongolia.
